prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE original square premium naturalistic painterly illustration of SHIVA for Mythics, respectful living Hindu sacred figure, monumental and immensely powerful but serene benevolent Protector. Low-angle full-body view looking upward from the rocky slopes of Kailasa: Shiva dominates the square, distant snowy mountain ridges tiny beneath him. One human head, exactly TWO arms and TWO legs, two normal eyes plus a clearly discernible THIRD vertical eye in the center of his forehead. Pale ash complexion and distinctly BLUE THROAT. High matted hair topknot with a crescent moon, a real physical serpent Vasuki around the neck. One hand holds a tall plain three-pronged trident; the other holds one small hourglass damaru drum. Cover chest, shoulders, waist and legs entirely with opaque modest traditional drapery and a tiger-skin patterned outer wrap; never shirtless. Visibly show his documented power: a powerful narrow tongue of orange-white FIRE issues from the FOREHEAD THIRD EYE into the upper air, not from either normal eye; Ganga is clear actual cascading WATER issuing from his matted topknot and descending beside him to the mountain. Keep fire and water visually distinct, face calm and readable. Radiant sunrise and firelight on cloth and mist; rich tactile brushwork, sculptural cinematic depth, strong silhouette, awe-inspiring divine scale. The exact scene and scale are artistic interpretation of accepted mountain-abode iconography; fire from third eye and water in hair are documented. No other supernatural effects. No extra heads, arms, fingers, halos, wings, lightning or magical ribbons. No victims, gore, nudity, text, inscriptions, labels, borders, logo, watermark. Entirely original design, no copying films, games, comics or existing artwork.
depicted_variant: Two-armed, one-headed Shiva the serene Protector on Kailasa with third-eye fire and the Ganga flowing from his matted topknot.
